Name: DE-Departments
Statement:
select  com.Oid as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        div.Oid as DivisionId,
        div.Name as Division,
        dep.Oid as DepartmentId,
        dep.Name as Department,
        dep.ModifiedOnUtc as ModifiedOn,
        dpt.Oid as DepartmentTypeId,
        dpt.Name as DepartmentType
from    Department dep
            join Division div on div.Oid = dep.Division
            join Company com on com.Oid = div.Company
            join DepartmentType dpt on dpt.Oid = dep.DepartmentType
